title: hymenodictyon timoranum
intro: Hymenodictyon timoranum, commonly known as the 'Timor Jasmine', is a flowering plant native to the Timor island in Indonesia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hymenodictyon timoranum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
